question: The Speaker of Lok Sabha, Om Birla, inaugurated the ________ on the occasion of 2021 World Tourism Day.
solution:
The correct answer is __**NIDHI 2.0 scheme.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On** 27 September 2021;** the Speaker of** Lok Sabha, Om Birla inaugurated the NIDHI 2.0 scheme.**
 
• The **National Integrated Database of Hospitality Industry (NIDHI) 2.0 **scheme has been launched on the** occasion of 2021 World Tourism Day (27 September 2021).**
 
• The event regarding this was organized by the** Ministry of Tourism.**
 
• The NIDHI 2.0 database will have more inclusivity, by not only including accommodation units, but also** travel agents, tour operators, & others.**

** NIDHI 2.0 scheme:-**

 
• The NIDHI scheme was** launched by the Ministry of Tourism **to facilitate the **digitalization of the tourism sector.**
 
• Its purpose is to** promote ease of doing business** for the hospitality & tourism sector.
 
• It focuses on encouraging all accommodation units to register themselves on the platform to** become part of the hospitality industry.**
 
• On the same occasion, the **Ministry of Tourism signed an MoU with the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).**
 
• The **Responsible Tourism Society of India (RTSOI)** also is** part of this MoU.**
 
• RTSOI is actively working to promote and support **sustainability initiatives** in the tourism sector for each other.
 
• It should be noted that India is in the unlocking phase and** domestic tourism **has re-started slowly and steadily.
 
• The Covid-19 pandemic has had an **immense socioeconomic impact worldwide.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ ** SAATHI 2.0 scheme:-

 
• Based on the requests received from all three State Governments, the second phase of the project, SATH-E 2.0, was commenced by NITI Aayog for 2 years, from October 2020.

 Swadesh Darshan scheme:-

 
• Swadesh Darshan Scheme is a scheme of the Ministry of Tourism under the Government of India. 
 
• The scheme aims to promote, develop and harness the potential of tourism in India.

** PRASHAD scheme:- **

 
• The Government of India launched the PRASAD scheme in the year 2014-2015 under the Ministry of Tourism. 
 
• The full form of the PRASAD scheme is the ‘Pilgrimage Rejuvenation And Spiritual Augmentation Drive’.
